villager_01: You're new here. Good — we need someone willing to fight.
Those creatures to the east are getting bolder. Kill a few and maybe the rest will think twice. I'll make it worth your while.
One more thing: keep an eye out for glowing scrolls on the ground. Pick one up, open your inventory (I key) or hotbar, select the scroll, and press F to equip it as an ability.
Equipped abilities show up in the Q and R slots to the left of your hotbar. Press Q or R in combat to unleash them.
shopkeeper_01: Welcome. I've got supplies if you've got gold — enemies drop it when they fall.
I also carry ability scrolls. Equip them from your inventory with F — they fill the Q and R slots next to your hotbar.
Bring me herbs if you find them. I'll pay well. Five should cover a fair price.
wanderer_01: I've been counting the creatures since I arrived. Haven't stopped coming.
If you're hunting them anyway, keep count. Kill enough of any kind and I'll have a reward for you.
The stone near the ruins is good quality too. I need a crate of it. Bring me eight pieces and I'll see you right.
guard_01: Turn back if you value your life. The creatures beyond these ruins are unlike anything I've seen.
We lost three scouts this week. Whatever's nesting in the deep caves, it's organized.
I can't leave my post. But you... you might be just crazy enough to make it through.
